summary: Xinyuan Real Estate Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that on July 8, 2026, it cancelled 45,912,240 ordinary shares surrendered for no consideration by CENTRAL PLAINS LTD. (15,339,280 shares) and XY MANAGEMENT LIMITED (30,572,960 shares). The shares were voluntarily returned and cancelled, reducing outstanding share count and potentially increasing per-share value for remaining holders. The filing provides no price, premium, or board recommendation details. Mechanics involved updating the Cayman Islands register of members. This cancellation is a capital return event, though voluntary and without consideration. What to watch: potential further cancellations or strategic actions by insiders, and any impact on share liquidity or control.
